optimizedDescription.value: Incremental two-pass indexer discovers, classifies, resolves, covers, and atomically persists one graph generation.

optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules
- `IndexCodeGraph`: Discover → Diff → Extract → Spec Index → Store → Clean → persist `lastIndexedRef`. Indexes source, documents, hierarchy, specs, dependencies, coverage.
- Consume `SpecRepository.list/artifact/readPersistedState` + `GetSpecMetadata`; no raw sidecar/metadata snapshot when self-healing materialization exists.
- Fingerprint = effective package version + canonical workspace hash + effective discovery filters/spec-root exclusions/`maxFileBytes`/`largeFilePaths`/`testPaths`/`ignorePaths`/project-relative `codeRoot`/path-semantics marker + newline-normalized hashes of adapter `resolutionManifests()`. Manifest discovery bounded by repo/project root through application port; no application-layer Node FS. Mismatch/incompatible schema → visible provider-owned recreation, generation rotation, full rebuild; reads never silently repair/empty-serve. Partial-workspace run clears only those workspaces.
- Incremental fingerprint-match: new/changed/deleted; content hash authoritative, mtime/size read-avoidance only. Hash match skips only when required persisted resource exists. Deletion scoped to indexed workspaces. Force permits no persisted-artifact skip. Retry every prior `parse-failed`/error-without-observation.
- Discovery: per workspace `codeRoot` with global+spec-root+workspace exclusions/allowed paths evaluated project-relative (two non-interchangeable layers; global cannot be re-included by workspace `!`); project-global includes outside every code root use `root:`. Adapter match→`FileNode`; textual fallback→`DocumentNode`; specs only via spec index. Paths use `/` without collapsing `.`/`..`; drive-letter keys are paths, never workspace IDs. Multi-workspace same physical file → bounded `workspaceOverlaps` warning diagnostic.
- `discoverFiles`: `respectGitignore` default true absolute priority; `vcsRoot` supplied or null, never probed. Default excludes include `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`. Binary extension filter precedes decode. Decode BOM UTF-8/16, then UTF-8, NUL-layout UTF-16, NUL-free windows-1252; else skip.
- Size gate: effective `maxFileBytes` (workspace→project→262144; `0`=unlimited) from FS metadata before read; `largeFilePaths` exemption project-relative. Oversized → coverage `unsupported`/`file-too-large`, no nodes; previously indexed now oversize removed. Import to size-skipped stays unresolved.
- Two-pass run-scoped `IndexSession`: before Pass1 build package map from every `packageResolution` adapter (all configured workspaces; inaccessible roots diagnostic+external); Pass1 analyzes per workspace, registers compact facts, emits `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`; between passes `prepare` + `reExportLinking`; Pass2 resolves `IMPORTS`/`CALLS`/`CONSTRUCTS`/`USES_TYPE`/hierarchy without reparse/store reads. One `bulkLoad()`, then one needed FTS rebuild.
- Parser-resource scope: at most one file's registered resources; close epoch on every exit path (dispose reverse order, drop refs, best-effort GC); disposal failure = typed diagnostic, not run failure. No run-wide parser collection; no `napi-keepalive`.
- Session owns compact file/analysis/symbol/document/spec lookups, facts, adapter cache, relation dedupe. Hydrated files contribute `namespace`+`namespaceSeparator`+name to QN lookup identically to analyzed. Test symbols hidden from non-test importers. No retained AST, raw-map bypass, persisted-ID/schema leakage.
- Shared scoped environment owns scopes, shadowing, bindings, receivers, candidates. Imported name resolves to bound declaration by id, never same-name local substitute. `IndexCodeGraph` contains no language rules. Persist deterministic relations only; drop self/unresolved/ambiguous edges.
- Coverage projection uses canonical persisted state against committing generation. File link→`COVERS_FILE` only if target exists; symbol link→`COVERS_SYMBOL` only after unique logical resolution anchored to file incl. public bindings. Run after re-export facts; never exact-name guess or file fallback. Reproject on implementation/code changes; stable per-link diagnostic.
- Specs: `count/list`; `GetSpecMetadata.metadataFingerprint` controls skip; title/description from materialization; coverage/dependencies from one persisted-state read. Prefer non-empty `optimizedDescription` for BM25/display.
- Package helpers generic: `matchSpecifier`→`entrySurface` (drop tests)→public bindings; resolve only unanimous logical target. Reasons: `facet-absent`/`package-unknown`/`no-entry-surface`/`not-exported`/`ambiguous`. Never first same-name. Persist `import:package` steps; diagnostics non-persisted; `package-unknown` → `externalPackageImports` only.
- Chunk budget default 20MB; optional staging under graph temp, run-scoped, clean on success/preferably failure.
- Success atomically replaces input observations for every file/document/spec physical input, hashes and VCS evidence, clears stale latches only on complete commit, prunes removed/obsolete. Failure/partial never clears stale. Failed analysis → `errors` + coverage `parse-failed`, no observation.
- Persist logical symbols, declaration occurrences, member semantics, bindings, hierarchy/provenance, coverage outcomes, indexed source text, parser-derived construct/name ranges. Store owned `qualified_name` exact dotted spelling; top-level none. `SymbolKind.Property` persists with container `parentId`. Cross-file overrides include every matching target declaration. Classification-aware: no manufactured logical target for binding-only/physical-only; absent group key never merges.
- Relation construction builds declaration/logical/import/public-binding indexes once; individual facts never scan full collections. Bounded batch writes; adapter reference facts precede spec projection.
- Incremental semantic refresh re-extracts new/changed + transitive importer/relation/hierarchy/public-route closure; addition-only of code files MAY reconsider unresolved-import candidates without counting unchanged content as indexed. Hydrate compact persisted facts for unchanged declarations. Full corpus replace only force/incompatibility/empty graph. Package-import closure uses reverse persisted steps, not full-file scans.
- Re-export propagation uses affected-route queues. Append bounded chunks to one bulk session, commit once, rebuild search at most once when searchable content changed. Fully unchanged run preserves semantic facts/relations and skips search rebuild while updating freshness metadata.
- Full/incremental equivalent source → equivalent nodes, ranges, facts, relations, search (incl. QN/namespace imports via hydrated lookup + all-workspace prepare). Progress/timings separately expose resolution, dependency, adapter, re-export, hierarchy, persistence, search phases. `IndexResult.fullRebuild` boolean + reason.
- Progress: 0–5 discovery/hash; 5–7 diff/cleanup; 7–50 Pass1; 50–80 Pass2; 80–83 specs; 83–95 bulk; 100 done; close each phase callback before heavy next work. Typed events: `file-activity`, `file-skipped`, `resource-disposal-failed`.
- Per-file errors collect and continue; infrastructure errors abort. `IndexResult` includes counts, size skips, overlaps, errors, diagnostics, duration, workspace breakdown, `vcsRef`, fingerprint, `fullRebuild`, reason, importDiagnostics.

## Constraints
- Caller opens store; indexer owns no lifecycle/backend.
- Provided `excludePaths` replaces defaults; gitignore exclusions cannot be re-included; global layer overrides workspace `!`.
- Pass 2 starts only after Pass 1 for all workspaces.
- Specs exclusively via workspace `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- Analysis environment uses in-memory facts only; no store queries.
- Unresolved facts and self-relations never persist.
- No language-specific indexer resolution; facets only; new language needs no indexer change.
- Pass 2 import resolution performs no filesystem I/O.
